# Membrane.FFmpeg.Transcoder

Source: https://membrane-ffmpeg-transcoder-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.FFmpeg.Transcoder.md

# `Membrane.FFmpeg.Transcoder`
[🔗](https://github.com/kim-company/membrane_ffmpeg_transcoder_plugin/blob/main/lib/membrane/ffmpeg/transcoder.ex#L1)

Tasks as input an unparsed stream and provides on each pad an unparsed, transcoded stream
with the desired properties.

Input might be MPEG-TS or FLV but other streaming containers might work as well. If the
input stream contains more than 1 video and 1 audio stream, which one will be picked is
undefined behaviour.
## Bin options

Passed via struct `t:Membrane.FFmpeg.Transcoder.t/0`

- `wait_random_access_indicator`  

  ```
  boolean()
  ```
  
  Default value: `true`  
  If enabled, emits packets only after the random access indicator is found
  in the MPEG-TS PES stream, otherwise packets are emitted immediately. When
  enabled, it means that the first video packet that comes out is going to
  be a keyframe unit.

## Pads

### `:input`

Accepted formats:
```
Membrane.RemoteStream
```

Direction: | `:input`
Availability: | `:always`

### `:scte`

Accepted formats:
```
Membrane.RemoteStream
```
```
Membrane.AAC
```
```
Membrane.H264
```

Direction: | `:output`
Availability: | `:on_request`
Pad options:

- `pid`  

  ```
  pos_integer()
  ```
  
  Default value: `nil`  
  PID of the SCTE stream. When `nil` it grabs the first stream.

### `:text`

Accepted formats:
```
Membrane.Text
```

Direction: | `:output`
Availability: | `:on_request`
Pad options:

- `source`  

  ```
  {:dvb_teletext, 100..899}
  ```
  
  ***Required***  
  Defines the source of the captions. Currently supported:
  * Teletext: `{:dvb_teletext, page_number}`

### `:video`

Accepted formats:
```
Membrane.RemoteStream
```
```
Membrane.AAC
```
```
Membrane.H264
```

Direction: | `:output`
Availability: | `:on_request`
Pad options:

- `copy`  

  ```
  boolean()
  ```
  
  Default value: `false`  
  If enabled, the stream will not be re-encoded

- `resolution`  

  ```
  {integer(), integer()}
  ```
  
  Default value: `{-2, 720}`  
  Resolution of the given output.

- `bitrate`  

  ```
  pos_integer()
  ```
  
  Default value: `3300000`  
  Maximum bitrate

- `profile`  

  ```
  atom()
  ```
  
  Default value: `:high`  
  H264 Profile

- `crf`  

  ```
  pos_integer()
  ```
  
  Default value: `26`  
  

- `preset`  

  ```
  atom()
  ```
  
  Default value: `:high`  
  

- `tune`  

  ```
  atom()
  ```
  
  Default value: `:zerolatency`  
  

- `fps`  

  ```
  pos_integer()
  ```
  
  Default value: `30`  
  

- `gop_size`  

  ```
  pos_integer()
  ```
  
  Default value: `60`  
  

- `b_frames`  

  ```
  pos_integer()
  ```
  
  Default value: `3`  
  

- `level`  

  ```
  String.t()
  ```
  
  Default value: `"3.1"`  
  

### `:audio`

Accepted formats:
```
Membrane.RemoteStream
```
```
Membrane.AAC
```
```
Membrane.H264
```

Direction: | `:output`
Availability: | `:on_request`
Pad options:

- `copy`  

  ```
  boolean()
  ```
  
  Default value: `false`  
  If enabled, the stream will not be re-encoded

- `codec`  

  ```
  :aac | :opus
  ```
  
  Default value: `:aac`  
  Audio codec to use for encoding. Ignored when copy is true.

- `bitrate`  

  ```
  pos_integer()
  ```
  
  Default value: `128000`  
  Maximum bitrate

- `sample_rate`  

  ```
  pos_integer()
  ```
  
  Default value: `48000`  
  

- `channels`  

  ```
  pos_integer()
  ```
  
  Default value: `2`  
  

# `audio_pad_opts`

```elixir
@type audio_pad_opts() :: [
  copy: boolean(),
  codec: :aac | :opus,
  bitrate: pos_integer(),
  sample_rate: pos_integer(),
  channels: pos_integer()
]
```

Options for pad `:audio`

# `scte_pad_opts`

```elixir
@type scte_pad_opts() :: [{:pid, pos_integer()}]
```

Options for pad `:scte`

# `t`

```elixir
@type t() :: %Membrane.FFmpeg.Transcoder{wait_random_access_indicator: boolean()}
```

Struct containing options for `Membrane.FFmpeg.Transcoder`

# `text_pad_opts`

```elixir
@type text_pad_opts() :: [{:source, {:dvb_teletext, 100..899}}]
```

Options for pad `:text`

# `video_pad_opts`

```elixir
@type video_pad_opts() :: [
  copy: boolean(),
  resolution: {integer(), integer()},
  bitrate: pos_integer(),
  profile: atom(),
  crf: pos_integer(),
  preset: atom(),
  tune: atom(),
  fps: pos_integer(),
  gop_size: pos_integer(),
  b_frames: pos_integer(),
  level: String.t()
]
```

Options for pad `:video`

# `options`

```elixir
@spec options() :: keyword()
```

Returns description of options available for this module

# Membrane.FFmpeg.Transcoder.Filter

Source: https://membrane-ffmpeg-transcoder-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.FFmpeg.Transcoder.Filter.md

# `Membrane.FFmpeg.Transcoder.Filter`
[🔗](https://github.com/kim-company/membrane_ffmpeg_transcoder_plugin/blob/main/lib/membrane/ffmpeg/transcoder/filter.ex#L1)

Internal module. Outputs MPEG-TS as an unparsed remote stream.
## Pads

### `:input`

Accepted formats:
```
Membrane.RemoteStream
```

Direction: | `:input`
Availability: | `:always`
Flow control: | `:auto`

### `:text`

Accepted formats:
```
Membrane.RemoteStream
```

Direction: | `:output`
Availability: | `:on_request`
Flow control: | `:auto`
Pad options:

- `source`  

  ```
  {:dvb_teletext, 100..899}
  ```
  
  ***Required***  
  Defines the source of the captions. Currently supported:
  * Teletext: `{:dvb_teletext, page_number}`

### `:ts`

Accepted formats:
```
Membrane.RemoteStream
```

Direction: | `:output`
Availability: | `:always`
Flow control: | `:auto`

# `text_pad_opts`

```elixir
@type text_pad_opts() :: [{:source, {:dvb_teletext, 100..899}}]
```

Options for pad `:text`
